hypothesis: At the same19440 acquired noisy-cell-response budget per deployment, move from90 source boards queried three times under H1ch's correlated-repeat process to270 source boards queried once. On72 fresh paired banks, the diverse single-response model recovers at least60/72 exact graphs and improves exact-recovery count over the supplied correlated model by at least48/72. mechanistic_motivation: H1ch both methods recovered0/72. Its supplied model knew the correct nominal joint channel, selected degree20 on all72 banks, and certified a strictly positive truth-objective gap in all72. Thus unknown channel parameters, degree selection and LP numerical failure are insufficient explanations. A remaining hypothesis is that correlated repeats provide too few independent source comparisons at this budget. Reallocating repeated responses to new underlying boards directly tests an acquisition remedy. This is not another rho sweep, a proof of information-theoretic impossibility, or a guarantee that the pair-composite objective is adequate.
